# Claude Code fixtures

`store/` is a synthetic Claude Code store, as `~/.claude/projects/-home-dev-shop` would be for a project in `/home/dev/shop`. Every record is hand-written: the structure follows what Claude Code writes, the content (paths, prompts, commands, ids) is made up. Never add a real transcript or an excerpt of one.

Times are UTC in the files; tests run in `Europe/Paris` (UTC+1 in March), so the badge session crosses local midnight.

| Session                                     | What it covers                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `5e1f0c2a-…` cart badge                     | `/clear`; prompts with a `human` origin; a response split over four records (thinking, text, two parallel tool calls); an error and an interrupted result followed by an interrupt; an image result; `AskUserQuestion`; a background `Bash` stopped by `TaskStop`; a background `Agent` whose completion is queued and then reported as a task-notification turn; a background build that finishes mid-turn (queued twice); a `Workflow` run; a synthetic API error; two models; two titles; a span across midnight. |
| `5e1f0c2a-…/subagents/agent-a1b2…`          | The background review agent, written mid-stream (no stop reasons), which launches another agent.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `5e1f0c2a-…/subagents/agent-a9f8…`          | The nested agent the review agent launched.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `5e1f0c2a-…/subagents/workflows/wf_3e9a…/`  | The `add-tests` workflow run's two agents (phases `plan` and `write`) and a journal that is not a transcript; `5e1f0c2a-…/workflows/wf_3e9a….json` is the run's summary.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `5e9b7c6d-…` older format                   | No record has an origin, so plain text is a prompt; a queued prompt; `WebFetch`, `Skill`, an MCP tool; `/model` and its output; shell commands with `git -C`, an environment assignment, and `pnpm --filter`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `c3d4e5f6-…` compaction                     | `/compact` whose summary and boundary are written before the command; a prompt from a `peer` origin; a last line cut off mid-write.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

`5e1f…` and `5e9b…` share the prefix `5e`, and the four agent ids share `a`, so ambiguous references can be tested.
